title: The Faithful Uniform
author: Casper Galloway
blurb: Vesper Dunmore, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
